name: llm-wiki-pm
description: PM knowledge base skill implementing Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Ingest sources, query a compounding markdown wiki, supersede with auto-link rewrite, crystallize transcripts into decision digests. Bundles wiki search (obsidian-mcp).

metadata.skillArchitecture: core (llm-wiki-pm) + 4 sub-skills (brief, research, maintain, review) + set-wiki-path utility

wiki_path.title: Wiki directory
wiki_path.description: Where to store your wiki (e.g. ~/my-wiki or ~/Documents/pm-wiki)

reviewer.title: Reviewer
reviewer.description: Who reviews wiki answers before you see them: "claude:opus" (default), "claude:sonnet", "claude:haiku", "claude" (account default model), "codex" (Codex CLI), or a shell command that reads the review prompt on stdin and prints the review

wiki_domain.title: Wiki domain
wiki_domain.description: Domain or scope for this wiki (e.g. "PM, Katalon" or "Personal")
